findings.title: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing fraction unavailable
findings.description: PSI mobile and desktop returned HTTP 429 (shared quota); no X/N obtained.
findings.recommendation: Configure a Google API key or run Lighthouse locally with --only-categories=agentic-browsing.

findings.title: No Content-Signal declaration
findings.description: robots.txt has a single * group with no Content-Signal line (draft preference, Google ignores it; checked 2026-09-23).
findings.recommendation: Optional: serve robots via route handler to add Content-Signal; app/robots.ts:6.

findings.title: No WebMCP markup on quote form
findings.description: 0 registerTool calls, 0 annotated forms (W3C CG draft, not a standard).
findings.recommendation: Optional: annotate the /quote form in components/sinovorex/QuoteForm.tsx:102.

findings.title: No Markdown delivery, ai-catalog.json or /.well-known files
findings.description: index.md, ai-catalog.json, security.txt, api-catalog return 404. Opportunities, not defects.

findings.title: Quote form relies on implicit labels and a hidden honeypot
findings.description: All 11 inputs are label-wrapped (0 unlabeled) but have no aria-describedby for hints; honeypot field 'website' may be filled by naive agents.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-describedby for hints at QuoteForm.tsx:32; keep the honeypot and note it in docs.
